data.narrative:
Magdrive, a Seed-stage space and aerospace company founded by Mark Stokes and Thomas Clayson, has raised $22.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 13 comparable companies: 5 public-market peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private-stage companies including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Only one triangulation method proved applicable to this analysis. The stage-progression approach, which uses a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage transitions, yields an implied valuation of $56M applied to the $22.5M total raised as a proxy for current value. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied because Magdrive's revenue is not on file, preventing use of the Space & Aerospace sector median P/S multiple of 26.4x. Peer-median analysis was likewise inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow peer set (0 matches across filtering criteria; 14 same-sector peers exist but fail tighter similarity thresholds).

The analysis supports a valuation range of $48M to $65M, with a median of $56M. This range carries material uncertainty given reliance on a single method and the absence of revenue-based anchoring common to mature-stage valuations. Key unknowns include Magdrive's revenue trajectory, cash burn rate, and near-term funding needs—variables that typically inform Seed-stage step-up multiples.
